	window.VTWatch = (function(){
		const KEY='vt_watch_v1', MAX=24, MAXAGE=14*24*60*60*1000; // keep 14 days (2 weeks)
		function load(){try{
			var l=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY))||[];
			var now=Date.now();
			// drop entries older than 14 days (2 weeks)
			l=l.filter(function(x){return x.t&&(now-x.t)<MAXAGE});
			return l;
		}catch(e){return[]}}
		function save(l){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(l.slice(0,MAX)))}catch(e){}}

		let cur=null;
		
		return {
			// call from player timeupdate: VTWatch.tick(currentSeconds)
			tick:function(sec){
				if(!cur)return;
				let l=load();
				const i=l.findIndex(x=>x.id===cur.id);
				if(i>-1){l[i].pos=Math.floor(sec);l[i].t=Date.now();save(l)}
				// sync to server (login user) — throttled to every ~15s
				if(window.VTUser&&VTUser.isLoggedIn()){
					const now=Date.now();
					if(!cur._lastSync||now-cur._lastSync>15000){
						cur._lastSync=now;
						VTUser.api('/history',{method:'POST',body:{video_id:cur.id,title:cur.title,thumb:cur.thumb,url:cur.url,position:Math.floor(sec)}});
					}
				}
			},
			// resume point for current video (seconds)
			resume:function(){
				if(!cur)return 0;
				const e=load().find(x=>x.id===cur.id);
				// don't resume if <30s watched or >90% done
				if(!e||e.pos<30||(e.dur&&e.pos>e.dur*0.9))return 0;
				return e.pos;
			},
			list:load,
			cur:function(){return cur;},
			remove:function(id){save(load().filter(x=>x.id!==id))},
			// CROSS-DEVICE: pull watch positions from the server (login users) and
			// merge into the local list, so Continue Watching + resume work on any device.
			syncFromServer:function(cb){
				if(!(window.VTUser&&VTUser.isLoggedIn&&VTUser.isLoggedIn())){ if(cb)cb(false); return; }
				VTUser.api('/history?offset=0&limit=24').then(function(d){
					var items=(d&&d.items)||[];
					if(!items.length){ if(cb)cb(true); return; }
					var l=load();
					items.forEach(function(sv){
						var id=parseInt(sv.video_id,10); if(!id)return;
						var pos=parseInt(sv.position,10)||0;
						var i=l.findIndex(function(x){return x.id===id});
						if(i>-1){ if(pos>l[i].pos)l[i].pos=pos; }   // server wins if further along
						else { l.unshift({id:id,title:sv.title||'',url:sv.url||('/?p='+id),thumb:sv.thumb||'',dur:0,pos:pos,t:Date.now()}); }
					});
					save(l);
					if(cb)cb(true);
				}).catch(function(){ if(cb)cb(false); });
			}
		};
	})();

	// render Continue Watching row if placeholder exists
	document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){
		const el=document.getElementById('vt-continue-row');
		if(!el)return;
		function renderRow(){
			const items=VTWatch.list().filter(x=>x.pos>30);
			if(!items.length){el.remove();return}
			let h='<div class="vt-cw-head"><h2>Continue Watching</h2></div><div class="vt-cw-scroll">';
			items.slice(0,10).forEach(x=>{
				const pct=x.dur?Math.min(100,Math.round(x.pos/x.dur*100)):0;
				const m=Math.floor(x.pos/60),s=String(x.pos%60).padStart(2,'0');

					<span class="vt-cw-thumb" style="background-image:url('${x.thumb}')">
						<span class="vt-cw-bar" style="width:${pct}%"></span>
						<span class="vt-cw-pos">▶ ${m}:${s}</span>
					</span>
					<span class="vt-cw-title">${x.title}</span>
				</a>`;
			});
			el.innerHTML=h+'</div>';
		}
		// login user → pull server history first (cross-device), then render
		if(window.VTUser&&VTUser.isLoggedIn&&VTUser.isLoggedIn()){
			VTWatch.syncFromServer(function(){ renderRow(); });
		} else {
			renderRow();
		}
	});
